subject: strandbeest
pitch:
Category: Abstract.
Subject: wind-walking beach creature of tubes.
Style: Theo Jansen kinetic sculpture.

spec.name: Strandbeest Tube Walker
spec.description: A Theo Jansen style wind-walking beach creature built of yellow tubes: a twin-wing sail up front, a crank spine, and six pairs of Jansen linkage legs with feet on the sand.
spec.layout: Long low walker facing +Z. Front: a pair of tall canted sail wings with white cloth on yellow tube frames, ahead of the spine. Middle: a central crank spine of three parallel tubes carrying a crank axle with offset crank discs. Both sides: three Jansen leg assemblies each, spaced along z, built of thin yellow tubes (triangle linkages) with blue-grey joint caps and dark rubber feet resting on y=0. Back: a ballast bottle cluster and a tail rudder fin. The style shows through uniform tube thickness, repeated triangle linkages, zip-tie and joint-cap details, and a bright yellow, white, grey palette. Everything symmetric about x=0.

parts.builds: Front sail: central mast tube, two wing frames canted outward (yellow tube rectangles with diagonal braces), white cloth membranes or thin slabs inside with sailShade seams, rope stays to the spine, joint caps at corners, small zip ties. Rides joint sail.
parts.attaches: Mast base at sailMast, stays run to spineFront.

parts.builds: Central crank spine: three parallel yellow tubes joined by cross-struts and grey joint caps, crank axle tube along x at crankAxle with offset crank discs and pins per leg phase, central bearing blocks, zip ties.
parts.attaches: Spine ends at spineFront and spineBack; axle at crankAxle feeds legs at legHip mounts.

parts.builds: Three Jansen linkage legs on the left (+X) side at z of legHipFront, Mid, Back, each with phase-shifted crank rods, triangle linkages of yellow tubes, grey joint caps, long lower leg tubes ending in dark rubber feet at y=0. Mirror-free: build x>0 side only.
parts.attaches: Hips and crank rods attach at legHip mounts and crankAxle.

parts.builds: Same three Jansen linkage legs on the right (-X) side, mirrored in x, with matching colours and feet at y=0.
parts.attaches: Hips and crank rods attach at legHip mounts and crankAxle.

parts.builds: Rear: cluster of blue plastic bottles (lathe bodies, red caps) lashed with rope and blue zip ties to a rear frame of yellow tubes, plus a vertical rudder fin of tubes with white cloth, and small sand-coloured sand-drift pads under the rear bottles kept above the floor.
